title: Steam
description: Configure Steam login and ownership rewards for this game. Changes apply immediately after saving.
keySaved: A key is saved securely. Leave this field empty to keep it, or enter a replacement. The saved key is never displayed.
keyMissing: No publisher key is saved. Enter a key with access to this game's Steam AppID.
removeKey: Remove the saved key (disable Steam first)
rewardCodeHint: Keep the code unchanged to prevent repeat grants. A new code allows all eligible owners to claim again. Leave the code and item list empty for login without rewards.
searchItems: Search this game's items by name
searchHint: Showing up to 20 matches. Refine the search to find another item. Up to 50 distinct items per reward.
noItems: No matching items available. Try another name.
itemsLoadFailed: Unable to search this game's items.
loadFailed: Unable to load Steam settings. Check your game access and reload the page.
saveFailed: Unable to save Steam settings. Check your permissions and try again.
invalid: Provide a valid AppID and publisher key to enable Steam. Reward items need quantities from 1 to 10000 and a code using letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens. For no rewards, clear both the code and item list.
itemInvalid: A reward item was removed or does not belong to this game. Choose the item again.
secretsUnavailable: Credential protection is unavailable. Contact the server administrator.
confirmDescription: Confirm with your Authenticator code. These settings control Steam login and item rewards for this game.
